Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 56

“Whose mind is untroubled in sorrow and free of longing in pleasure, who is rid of passion, fear, and anger — that one is called a sage of steady mind.”

Note the pairing: untroubled in sorrow and unhungry in pleasure. Krishna keeps insisting that the seductive half of experience is every bit as destabilizing as the painful half.
